g.text: 07 Power on and check idle behavior
Start after the firmware startup check. Keep both supplies connected for the REP test.
3 Send no command and leave the Qwiic Button untouched.
Expected: both pumps and the valve stay still.
If anything moves, unplug the 12 V adapter and stop.
